IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_Units: This spot has %1 of %2 diggings left.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_FitSalt: The pan set over the hole and bedded in clay round its foot; the clay is lost when it comes off. It holds 30 L of brine and boils it down to a crust of salt: 1 Evaporated Salt for each litre of Brine. Top it up any time.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_PanCrus: Salt Pan: dry, %1 Evaporated Salt to scrape
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_PanStat: Salt Pan: %1 / %2 L of brine, %3 C
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_PanNoBr: You have nothing with brine in it (Brine and water only).
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_PourInt: Room for %1 L. The salt stays in the pan as the water boils off.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_ScrapeP: Scrapes out %1 Evaporated Salt. Part of a portion left over is lost.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_PanHelp: Pour brine into the pan and light the fire: it comes to the boil in about half an hour and boils off 6 L an hour, leaving the salt.
Boiled dry: scrape the salt out with a knife. It waits, even on the fire.
The fire is out: the brine cools and waits. Add fuel and light it.
Banked: the embers keep the pan at the boil but boil it off a third as fast. Stoke the fire to boil it down.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_EmptyPa: Pours away all %1 L of brine, and the %2 Evaporated Salt in it. There's no getting it back.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_DropIdl: Drop soil, water or brine here
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_NoteVat: Tip saline soil in (up to 3 sacks), then pour water or brine over it. The brine drips into the tub: draw it off into any container.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_VatSoak: %1 L, waiting: the tub is full
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_VatTooW: too weak to boil to a salt.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_VatSoak: Let the liquid soak through first.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_VatSoil: The bed holds 3 sacks of soil with salt in them.
Put soil in the vat first.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_VatBedF: The bed holds 30 L at a time.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_VatNoSa: You have no Sack of Saline Soil.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_VatNoLi: You have nothing holding water or brine (and nothing else).
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_VatNoCa: You have no empty container, or one of brine, to draw it into.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_VatTake: The vat takes Sacks of Saline Soil, and water or brine.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_AddSoil: Tips the sack onto the bed, on top: %1 salt in it. Spent soil is thrown out. You keep the sack.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_PourOnS: Room for %1 L. It soaks through at 5 L an hour, picking up salt from every layer of soil, into the tub below.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_DropSoi: Tips %1 sacks of soil on the bed.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_NoteVat: Leaching goes by the clock, rain or shine. A deeper bed gives stronger brine; salt the liquid leaves stays in the soil for the next pour.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_PanDrop: The salt pan takes brine only.
Pour in %1 L (%2 L of Brine)
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationSalt_PanDrag: Drag buckets of brine onto the pan to pour them in.
